0022600095.text: The Dallas Mavericks, 0-1 and 11th in the West, visit the Indiana Pacers, who are 1-0 and 7th in the East, in the Mavericks' second game of the 2026-27 season. Dallas won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 134-130 win in Indianapolis on February 22, 2026, and the two teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27. Dallas is missing Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Jett Howard (calf soreness), Santi Aldama (knee surgery) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring).
